commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_MAIN=d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad
EXPECTED_BRANCH=e040f6e2287a3ad18ae041697ff6527cf3185363
SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J
PACKAGE=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCH"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
adb devices -l | grep -F "$SERIAL" | grep -F 'device ' | grep -F 'model:SM_S906B'
CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -m1 mCallState || true' | tr -d '\r')
BT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '\r')
LLAMA=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null || true' | tr -d '\r[:space:]')
REPORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PACKAGE" cat files/chat-relay-live-call-report.txt | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$REPORT" | grep -E '^(probe|developer_relay|call_required|max_turns|approval_policy|endpointing|timestamp_utc|media_generation|turn_[0-9]+_(started|stt_ready|stt_ready_elapsed_ms|stt_chars|stt_elapsed_ms|approved_chars|approved_elapsed_ms|output_pcm_ready_elapsed_ms|rx_pcm_bytes|endpoint_reason|endpoint_capture_ms|speech_detected|estimated_eos_elapsed_ms|tts_pcm_duration_ms|post_tx_hold_ms|first_tx_elapsed_ms|eos_to_first_tx_ms|tx_write_wall_ms|tx_pcm_bytes|complete_elapsed_ms)|turns_completed|telephony_rx_pcm_bytes|telephony_tx_pcm_bytes|chat_relay_live_call_success|failure_reason|probe_complete)='
echo post_call_call_state="$CALL_STATE"
echo post_call_bluetooth_on="$BT"
echo post_call_llama_running=$([ -n "$LLAMA" ] && echo true || echo false)
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_metrics_audit_complete=true
